extraction_text: Nothing contained in this Agreement is to be construed as a limitation of the right of the Employer to exercise the regular and customary functions of management, including the right to direct the employees, covered by this Agreement to perform all work involving the maintenance, repair and modernization of elevators and escalators, and also the installation of elevators and escalators (with the exception of a completely new elevator or escalator installation using new equipment or used equipment not part of the existing installation) in existing or modified elevator shafts or escalator well ways.
(a) Employers may staff modernization work with two (2) five (5) day eight (8) hour shifts when contractually required.
